title: K-FIELD SOLAR-SYSTEM COUPLING ANALYSIS
subtitle: Volume-Filling Cell3 Origin Lock, Daily Body-CMB Kinematics, Body-Sun Differential Force, and the Phase-Shifted Orbital Response

frame.ephemeris_origin: Solar-System barycenter for absolute states; Sun for heliocentric differential states
frame.origin_effect: origin fixes spatial Cell3 indexing; current uniform G_phase force vectors are translation invariant

analysis_summary.ephemeris_method: JPL approximate Keplerian elements Table 1 (1800-2050), converted to ICRF; finite-difference velocities; mass-weighted SSB reconstruction

trajectory_variational_response.definition: causal linearized body-Sun trajectory perturbation, zero delta-r and delta-v at start; not refitted initial state

one_period_fixed_force_test.interpretation: for complete inner-planet orbits, fixed force does nearly zero net work but changes eccentricity vector; induced aphelion is approximately +90 deg from projected force for prograde near-circular motion
